name: Mundilactes
source:
Three young denizens of the Habitat have just chosen their faces and must now go to the other side of their (admittedly small) world to be bestowed a name. They’re having a bad time.

[From [url=https://aresnergal.itch.io/mundilactes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
栖息地的三名年轻居民刚刚选择了他们的面孔，现在必须前往他们（诚然很小）世界的另一边去获得一个名字。他们过得很糟糕。

[来自[url=https://aresnergal.itch.io/mundilactes]Itch.io[/url]]
